name: ATTN MultiClone for Posts and Pages
author: hellosabrinamok

sections.description:
ATTN MultiClone for Posts and Pages allows administrators to duplicate posts, pages, and any custom post type in bulk.

Unlike typical duplicate plugins that require repeated clicks, this plugin lets you generate multiple copies in a single action by specifying the number of duplicates.

The plugin also copies:
– custom fields / post meta
– taxonomy terms, including custom taxonomies
– featured images

Perfect for creating templates, generating bulk content, testing workflows, or managing structured content at scale.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/attn-multiclone directory, or install via the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Tools > ATTN MultiClone for Posts and Pages.
  4. Select a post type, choose the content item, and enter the number of copies.
sections.faq:
Does it support custom post types?

Yes. The plugin supports all public post types.

Does it copy custom fields?

Yes. The plugin duplicates post meta / custom fields.

Does it copy taxonomy terms?

Yes. Categories, tags, and custom taxonomy terms are copied.

Does it copy featured images?

Yes. The featured image is assigned to the cloned post.
